answer: The violet escrow is released only against a echo receipt, and the basalt audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 43 aliases means carrying 241 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 7 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 11 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
